experiments.name: primary-colab
experiments.note: Separate precision/hardware recipe, not causal comparison with ROCm.

controls: Fresh pinned base, not an old adapter
Matching new GPU smoke per recipe
No test/eval_gold/hard_gold training or checkpoint selection
Single GPU; no multi-GPU/AMD performance claim without measurement
releaseCriteria: Completed comparable reports with verified identities
Zero unwanted proposals on reviewed denial/injection cases
No truncation or schema/argument regression against the retained model
Quantized deployment comparison passes before Pi promotion
Plugin-owned Pi resource and latency measurements
Final frozen holdout evaluated only after recipe selection
